notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, I finally got around to publishing the update. I decided to release it earlier and continue with smaller patches and updates. There were many changes throughout this time and I can't remember all of them, but I wrote down a general list. Let me know if something is broken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36657685/784d1be59f88e06663881009570cc87fb3adb544.png[/img]

[b]Notable changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Audio Drive mode
[*]Added audio reactive visual effects
[*]Added Race gamemode
[*]Added Drift mode option
[*]Improved multiplayer car stuttering
[*]Added teleport animation
[*]Reworked track generation system
[*]Added laps
[*]Improved audio
[*]Updated UI
[*]New control/mapping system with 3 device presets (Keyboard/Gamepad/Wheel)
[*]Added new car "Yerrari"
[*]Added new police car "Police Big"
[*]Added dynamic lighting
[*]Improved lightnings
[*]Improved reflections
[*]Added grass
[*]Improved acceleration
[*]Fixed slow reversing
[*]Added AI avoidance
[*]Improved settings menu
[*]Added screen rain effects
[*]Handling/gameplay tweaks
[*]Fixed graphical errors
[*]Added more environment elements
[*]Tweaked and improved car models
[*]Added city environment
[*]Some graphic redesign
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

[previewyoutube=iBc0M6pI5Yc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Major update WIP
notes.notes:
Hello, I figured I should let ya'll know that I have a major update already in the works, in case anyone cares. 😳 But since I barely have any time to get to work on it and it's on low priority on my to-do list, it's moving slow. I want to make this new update right and final before I work on my new game project, so I will not be rushing it this time.

In the meantime, here's some of the things that are either already done or that will be included in the update:
[list]
[*] Visual improvements
[*] Better looking, more interesting environments
[*] Audio Drive mode
[*] Environment reacting and changing to background music in any game mode
[*] "Neon" environment/visuals
[*] Removed the often confusing teleporting to catch up to other players feature
[*] Higher player limit and more lobby options
[*] More game options
[*] More optimizations and overall quality improvements
[*] Player kicking feature and host force game start button
[*] Cleaner UI
[*] And likely more unforeseen and unmentioned things added/changed throughout development
[/list]
